problem:
Consider the linear transformation $T$ with matrix representation $T,$ given by

$$
T=[\begin{aligned}2 & 1 \\ -1 & 2\end{aligned}].
$$

A line segment $\overset{―}{AB}$ has endpoints at $A(-1,2)$ and $B(1,1).$ What are the coordinates of the corresponding endpoints of $\overset{―}{{A}^{′}{B}^{′}}$, the image of $\overset{―}{AB}$ under the action of $T?$
